items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: The road manager, Frenchy, he'd go looking for things of this sort... when I was over there with Louis in Europe

ctx.x: But you can't blame -- you can't blame the guy for do -- if he hadn't done it, probably somebody else would have done it, but the bad thing was they were supposed to have been friends, you know. This is how that thing works, you know. There's so much of that went on.

You know, when I was over there with Louis in Europe, they used to find trucks out in the back with all kind of electronic gadgets, picking up the whole concert, trucks full of electronic gadgets. They found a few, but how many got away with it? You know, you couldn't -- they were high on electronics many years ago over there, especially through Germany.
